newsitem.title: USA: SBC seeks to resolve telecomm act challenge.
newsitem.headline: SBC seeks to resolve telecomm act challenge.

text.p: SBC Communications said Wednesday it took action to resolve its challenge of the Telecommunications Act of 1996 by sighting irreparable harm, including denial of business opportunities, loss of customer goodwill and infringement of First Amendment rights.
The company said it moved for a summary judgement by the U.S. District Court, Northern District of Texas, Wichita Falls District, who is hearing the case.
On July 2, the company sued to declare a portion of the act unconstitutional on the grounds it discriminates against itself and the five remaining Bell Operating companies.
SBC said the Act prohibits it and the other companies from competing for long distance and other services that local exchange companies are free to provide.
The company said the restrictions are referred to in the Act as "Special Provisions Concerning Bell Operating Companies."
